title: WaterstaatsArchieven Databestand (WAD), 1255-1980
descriptions: Data on the history of water board districts in The Netherlands during the period 1255-1980. The data set includes year of foundation and liquidation of water board districts, and information on the archives (name of archive, size in metres, available inventories).
